name: Rebuild a whole page as code with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild a whole page as code
Set the URL and the output (Tailwind, React, HTML or Vue) in **Read the page** and **Rebuild each section**. MiroMiro rebuilds every section in a real browser; open **pagePreviewUrl** on the last node to see the whole page assembled, with a Download HTML button. 25 credits per section; repeat calls within 24h are free.

**Setup**
1. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
2. Open the MiroMiro node > Credential > Create new, paste the key.
3. Click **Execute workflow**.
